articles.summary: AT&T cut its AI bill by 56%, Uber reduced cost per session by 52%, and Pinterest is running open models at less than 8% of closed model costs, all while maintaining or expanding AI usage. The shift is not toward less AI but toward deliberate routing, and the companies with the best visibility into their model stack will have a structural cost advantage over those still defaulting to frontier models for every task.
articles.title: The AI Cost Curve Is Finally Becoming Visible
